items.title: Build the package in a workflow, and attest what it built

slices.statement: The .deb is built by a GitHub Actions workflow rather than a workstation
actions/attest-build-provenance attests the artifact and gh attestation verify accepts it
The signing policy records the attestation prerequisite as met, derived from the workflows

items.title: Create the release signing key, and sign what ships

slices.statement: A release key exists under the custody I5 decided, separate from the evidence key
Release artifacts and SHA256SUMS are signed and RFC 3161 timestamped
verify_release_set.py accepts a set that records itself as signed because it carries signatures

items.title: Give a packaged installation a supported way to delete its data

slices.statement: notriosctl purge carries the verified backup, the explicit-flag refusal and the symlink protection
Sync key material is excluded from the backup it writes
The v0.9 I4 drills pass against a packaged installation, and the frozen CLI surface is re-recorded
A profile whose library lives outside the roots is enumerated in the plan and never deleted
A registered profile path reports and never blocks a purge, including one naming a parent of the roots

items.title: Stabilise the REST and MCP surfaces for 1.0

slices.statement: Every frozen REST route and MCP tool has derived evidence and a recorded review decision
Every advertised MCP tool is named by a test, gated so a fourth untested one fails
The one change that would break a wire protocol is recorded for the owner rather than made

items.title: Prove the library at scale

slices.statement: Import, export and restore are measured on real libraries at 382,206 notes
The two-format corpus separates importer cost from store cost, and the difference is traced to a call site
What degraded at scale is recorded, including an external comparison that names what each tool builds

items.title: Ship the versioned no-GUI library and header artifacts

slices.statement: A versioned tarball carries libnotrios.so.1, the header, licence, readme and SHA256SUMS, built and attested by the release workflow for the I7-supported platform
Six C examples -- lifecycle, ownership, threading, errors, streams, compatibility -- compile and run against the extracted artifact rather than the source tree
The I8 ABI baseline is re-derived and unchanged, or the move is recorded with its reason

items.title: Validate backup, export, restore, sync compatibility and disaster recovery

slices.statement: Archives and library files written by 0.7.0, 0.8.0 and the v0.9 close restore and open in 1.0 with their content intact, and a 1.0 archive is refused clearly by each older version
Sync between 1.0 and each older version is refused cleanly in both directions, and replicas syncing on an older version keep syncing after both are upgraded to 1.0
A disaster-recovery drill destroys and restores a library at the scale J5 measured

items.title: Security review for remote media and MCP

slices.statement: Remote-media localization is attacked and recorded: reserved ranges the private check may miss, DNS rebinding, redirect chains, host forms, lying servers, quarantine handling and provenance

The MCP surface is reviewed for what a client can reach: every tool classified and enforced on every dispatch path, out-of-scope tools absent as well as refused, the sync scope orthogonal, and the default scope written down
Every finding carries a disposition: accepted with a reason, or deferred to a named new plan item; no product code changes in this item

items.title: Publish the release documentation for the supported matrix

slices.statement: Installation and support documentation carries exact OS, architecture and runtime rows
Migration, rollback, disaster-recovery and artifact-authenticity instructions are published
No sentence remains that J1, J2 or J3 made untrue

items.title: Publish the user-authorized release

slices.statement: develop and main are synchronized, CI and the pre-push evidence gates pass, and the evidence is sealed
The release is created from reviewed main on the owner's explicit authorization
The published tag, notes, installers, checksums, signatures, SBOM, provenance and downloaded bytes are verified after publication

items.title: Report the installation's structure and manifest, and verify a purge against it

slices.statement: `notriosctl paths report` lists every directory holding Notrios files or data and every file by absolute path, marking what is outside the owned roots, as a report, as JSON and as one path per line
A clean install's structure and manifest are captured as a record
scripts/check_purged.sh reads a pre-purge path manifest with nothing but a shell, requires every owned path gone and every external library still present, and fails when one owned file is left

items.title: Make the README true, and generate what can be generated

slices.statement: The README's project status is generated from the ledger and gated, like the plan's and the roadmap's
The opening is readable and Quick start covers install, uninstall, purge, clean and clobber
docs/configuration.md documents every configuration key, checked against internal/config, and the README points at it
The documentation site can be built and served locally, said in the README, and _site staleness is detectable

items.title: Generate the published command-line examples from executed runs

slices.statement: Every fenced block in docs/ is classified as synopsis, recipe or transcript, and the gaps are reported per document
A per-document tracked example set generates its published command lines, gated against the recorded run
Each configuration section shows what to run and which other keys must be set with it, and each example runs
Unverified hand-written recipes are executed and generated, or carry a reason naming where they do run

items.title: Stop leaving bytecode behind, and derive the evidence index

slices.statement: Every Python invocation in the repository runs with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
A check reports when a validate run has left bytecode behind
The README's Validation section is split, and its evidence index is generated from performance/ and gated

items.title: Migrate the remaining documents to the tracked example set

slices.statement: A recipe kind is added to the tracked schema and proven on one page: it declares the CLI commands and REST routes it uses, checked against the frozen surfaces, and the generator moves the registry hash
Every document is either generated from its tracked set or carries a recorded reason it is not, in a tracked record, and a migration changes no published byte
No generated page's fence can be hand-edited, and no generated page's registry hash is moved by a human
The troubleshooting page's import rows quote the errors the importers return, and a check fails when a quoted error leaves the source

items.title: Give the carrier write its own path shape

slices.statement: The carrier write has a literal path segment, so no two carrier routes share a shape
api/openapi.yaml describes each carrier path once, with parameter names that mean something
The frozen REST surface and J4's review are re-recorded, and sync exchange still round-trips

items.title: Batch the per-item work J5 found in import and export

slices.statement: A CPU profile names where the Obsidian importer's per-note time goes, after five call-site hypotheses were tested and rejected
The Obsidian importer uses the batch link rebuild, with the same corpus re-measured beside the old number
Every remaining per-item store call in import and export is either batched or recorded

items.title: Stop scanning the full-text index on every document write

slices.statement: A document_id to rowid mapping exists and is populated for an existing library by migration
All ten call sites delete from documents_fts by rowid, with search results proven unchanged
The write-cost measurement is re-run on the same three libraries, beside the old numbers

items.title: Test the external performance review, and adopt only what measures better

slices.statement: Every review suggestion that survives a source check is measured on J5's corpora and given a recorded verdict
Only the suggestions J19-A measured as improvements are implemented, each with its own before and after
Import counts, unchanged-item fingerprints, search results and J18's mapping are proven unchanged

items.title: Finish the Obsidian inventory memory work, on a fresh J5 baseline

slices.statement: J5's Obsidian and Joplin corpora are re-imported in full under the current code, one run at a time, beside J5's numbers
The Obsidian inventory's duplicated structs and hex hashes are measured on the full vault and changed only where held memory falls, with equivalence proven
The Obsidian import is re-run after J20-B under J20-A's conditions, with the difference stated at the size measured

items.title: Stop re-running schema migrations every time a library is opened

slices.statement: Opening a library at the current schema runs no migration step's work, proven by a test that fails if any guarded step runs again
Fresh, older and current libraries still reach the same schema, proven by comparing their schemas before and after the change
Open cost and search are re-measured on both 382,206-note libraries beside J20-A's numbers

items.title: Stop stores and tests leaving directories in the temp root

slices.statement: A store that created its own temp asset root removes it on Close, and never removes an asset root a caller supplied

Each instance keeps its temporary work in its own data.temp_dir, one locked subdirectory per process, removes only its own crashed processes' leftovers, and never touches another instance's temp files
The CLI tests' shared binary directory is removed, validators stop defaulting Go caches into the temp root, and a check runs the Go suite in a fresh temp root and fails on any notrios-* entry left

items.title: Keep existing sync peers syncing after both upgrade in place

slices.statement: A paired peer whose handshake differs from its stored compatibility only by a schema rise both sides' ranges admit is accepted, and the stored record is updated with an audit event
A paired peer whose protocol, capabilities or identity differ from its stored compatibility is still refused, proven by security tests
J7's upgrade-in-place drill converges on the original pairing for 0.7.0, 0.8.0 and v0.9

items.title: Check the running agent's own usage, not every agent's

slices.statement: The usage preflight checks the running agent's own quota, identified as the nearest coding agent in its process ancestry, then an explicit NOTRIOS_AGENT_USAGE_AGENT only when ancestry finds none, then all

Tests prove classification, nearest-ancestor resolution, ancestry winning over leaked environment, each fallback, and that a Claude or Codex run is paused only by its own quota with the other agent's probe never called
Every caller of the preflight gets the selection without changes of its own, and the guard's documentation says whose usage is checked and how to choose

items.title: Import a Twitter/X archive as it is downloaded, completely, at its real size

slices.statement: notriosctl import twitter reads the downloaded ZIP in place and every tweets part, imports community posts, skips and counts deleted posts, and checks the count against tweet-headers.js
Post files are stream-decoded and media streamed, with entry-count, decompressed-size and media-size bounds tested against hostile archives
The owner's 3.3 GB archive is dry-run, imported and re-imported with phase timings, peak RSS, and every post and media file accounted for

items.title: Import ChatGPT, OpenAI Privacy Portal and Claude archives as downloaded

slices.statement: J25's ZIP-or-folder archive reader moves to a shared package, gains nested-ZIP support read in place, and the Twitter/X importer keeps its behaviour and tests

import chatgpt accepts the downloaded ZIP and every conversations shard, one note per conversation in the ChatGPT notebook, with referenced assets imported as resources and matched under either the file- or file_ id prefix

import chatgpt accepts the OpenAI Privacy Portal ZIP, reads its nested Conversations and Files ZIPs in place, recovers .dat names and types from the asset map then library_files.json then sniffing, and imports the file library with unreferenced files as stub notes
import claude accepts the downloaded ZIP and batch siblings, one note per conversation in the Claude notebook with attachment text and file references, and one note per project
Code and execution output become fenced code blocks and browsing results text, while thinking, reasoning recaps and tool plumbing are counted rather than imported
The owner's ChatGPT, Privacy Portal and Claude archives are each dry-run, imported and re-imported with timings, peak RSS, and every conversation and asset accounted for

items.title: Normalise a host before matching it against the domain lists

slices.statement: A trailing-dot host matches the same private check and blocked, allowed and review patterns as its undotted form, and a host with an empty label is blocked as malformed, proven by cases for every list (J8 finding J8-F1)

items.title: Refuse the reserved address ranges remote media must not reach, by a named default the configuration can state

slices.statement: SECURITY_AND_MEDIA_POLICY.md names a dated default refusal set with each range's purpose and source, the ranges left out and why, the embedded-IPv4 rule, and the owner's decisions (J8 finding J8-F2)
One helper applies the effective set, the embedded-IPv4 rule and the exceptions at the static check and at the connect-time check, with a case per default range at both

security.remote_media states the refused and permitted ranges, the default applies when absent, a malformed entry fails loading, and config show and service start report the effective set, its origin and every omitted default range
The configuration, service, example-config, security-review and troubleshooting documents say how to state the refused ranges, and J8's multicast wording is corrected

items.title: Decide which HTML reference forms the remote-media scanner is responsible for

slices.statement: The scanner finds every covered media element and attribute (img, source, video, audio, track, embed, object, SVG image; src, srcset, poster, data, href) quoted or unquoted, does not report inline data: URIs, and the policy records what the scan does not promise (J8 finding J8-F3)

items.title: Stop a lying Content-Type header deciding the type of an inconclusive payload

slices.statement: With an inconclusive sniff the header is followed only for named media types whose signature is in the payload; a payload that contradicts its claimed type is refused, and SVG, TIFF, AVIF, HEIC, MOV, frame-led MP3 and FLAC still localize (J8 finding J8-F4)

items.title: Bring the vendored Ledger theme up to its Bluge result-URL fix

slices.statement: The production theme copy is validated against its own provenance while the frozen G18b snapshot and G18g evidence validate unchanged
docs-site/themes/hugo-theme-ledger is refreshed from a GitHub clone at the upstream commit carrying the Bluge fix, with provenance recording the commit, counts and manifest
The docs site builds, validates and searches on the refreshed copy, and the theme's own tests pass at the pinned commit

items.title: Investigate the import performance review's findings, and keep only what measurement shows is faster

slices.statement: A synthetic benchmark matrix, a prepared-statement counter and a baseline with dispersion exist before any candidate is measured
F1, reusing prepared block and link insert statements, is kept or reverted on its measured prepare count and wall time
Building PropertyOrder only when source is preserved is kept or reverted on its measured heap and peak RSS
Single-pass Obsidian replacement assembly is kept or reverted on the link-dense corpus, after overlapping-match behaviour is pinned
F8, one-pass link coordinates, is kept or reverted on the link-dense corpus with offsets, columns and order unchanged
F9, collision-heavy namespace construction, is kept or reverted on the collision corpus without costing memory on the ordinary corpus
Hashing Obsidian Markdown from bytes already read is kept or reverted on warm and dropped-cache inventory time
F3, existence-only store reads, is kept or reverted on measured allocations and wall time with deleted-note filtering unchanged
F2, reusing current blocks in the final link pass, is kept or reverted after its revision invariant is proven
Checkpoint consolidation is measured and reverted, and the stable-note skip is deferred to J39 with its design recorded, because it needs a schema addition this item's boundaries exclude
F5, byte-bounded batches, is kept or reverted on peak RSS with near-limit notes, and a single large note still imports
The smaller candidates are each measured and dispositioned, the database experiments first because SQLite is now 48.5% of the import
markdownTitle stops converting a whole note between []byte and string, or the change is reverted on its measurement
Assembling the canonical body once is withdrawn: J32-U is that change, measured there
A block's text is a slice of the body rather than rejoined lines, or the change is reverted on its measurement
The per-block allocations in Extract are reduced, or the change is reverted on its measurement
Block storage is reused across notes instead of allocated per note, or the change is reverted on its measurement
Whether an edit script beats stage-by-stage copying is decided by a measured prototype, and recorded either way
Withdrawn: the copies it targeted are 5.3% of the import, and its largest item was removed by J32-H and J32-I
A block's text is sliced rather than rebuilt when trimming changes nothing, and hashed without a second copy, or the change is reverted on its measurement
A note is read, edited and written from one in-memory representation within the write path, or each step is reverted on its measurement
A body is bound to SQLite without being copied into C memory first, or the change is reverted on its measurement
Link extraction matches without a regexp engine, held to the regexps it replaces, or the change is reverted on its measurement
A block's trailing marker is found by reading its tail rather than scanning the block, or the change is reverted on its measurement
A body is hashed once per import rather than twice, sized first by a counter of bytes hashed, or the change is reverted on its measurement
performance/v1.0-j32/README.md gives every review finding a disposition backed by a measurement or a stated reason, and defers any correctness defect to its own item
The link-resolution title lookup uses the title index when a collection is given, or the change is reverted on its measurement

items.title: Decide whether Ogg media and comment-led SVG are localizable

slices.statement: Ogg localizes as audio/video with a .ogg quarantine name, .ogv and .opus are media extensions, an SVG that opens with a comment stays refused because its bytes sniff as text/html, and the policy records both decisions

items.title: Stop the preview loading remote images through media elements

slices.statement: The preview sanitizer neutralises every J29-covered remote media reference as it does img, the CSP states media-src, and a rendered-note test proves no remote request is made

items.title: Make G18g's browser smoke runnable again

slices.statement: The documented browser smoke command completes, with the reason the theme control was not clickable recorded
The smoke, G18g's README, DOCS_SITE.md and FEATURE_MATRIX.md name the apex address the site is served at instead of the GitHub Pages subpath, which is recorded as the historical fallback
A check run with make validate fails when a tracked file names a base address contradicting docs-site/hugo.toml's baseURL, with historical mentions listed and a test proving it both ways

items.title: Resolve Obsidian partial-path links the way Obsidian does

slices.statement: Tests pin how a partial-path link resolves, confirmed against Obsidian's behaviour, and fail on today's code
Note and attachment links naming exactly one file by partial path resolve to it, with ambiguous ones still warned and unresolved
What reimporting a vault imported before the fix revises is recorded, and a no-op reimport of an unaffected vault still creates no revisions

items.title: Decide what a link matched by both patterns should be

slices.statement: What both patterns record for one span today is stated by a test, as the description any decision is compared against
Which row survives for a span both patterns match is decided and recorded with its reason, leaving no overlapping byte ranges
The rewrite, the stored-row resolution, the backlink listing and the preview follow the decision, shown by importing a vault that uses the form

items.title: Carry J32's import findings into the Joplin importer, where they measure

slices.statement: A Joplin import is profiled for CPU and allocations before any change, and which J32 findings already apply through shared code is recorded
Joplin's existence-only reads ask for presence, or the change is reverted on its measurement
Joplin batches are bounded by bytes as well as item count, or the change is reverted on its measurement
Joplin reads each item into a reused capped buffer, or the change is reverted on its measurement
Whatever the profile names beyond this list is measured and dispositioned on its own
performance/v1.0-j38/README.md records every finding as carried, rejected or already shared

items.title: Skip a note a reimport cannot change

slices.statement: The canonical body hash is recorded per import item, and an item without one is not skippable
A note is skipped only when the import fingerprint is unchanged and its recorded hash matches the stored revision's, so a diverged note is still repaired
A reimport with every note skipped still leaves the library as a fresh import would, with the link pass, item states and checkpoint intact
The skip is kept or reverted on wall time, hashed bytes and read bytes for no-op and 1%-changed reimports, the latter a scenario the harness gains
